llc.formation_doc: Certificate of Formation - Limited Liability Company (Form 205)
llc.formation_notes: Form 205 Revised 09/26. Professional LLCs use Form 206. Credit card convenience fee applies online (exact % not verified).

annual_report.name: No Secretary of State annual report; annual franchise tax report plus Public Information Report (Form 05-102) or Ownership Information Report (Form 05-167) filed with the Comptroller
annual_report.late_penalty: $50 penalty on each report filed after the due date; 5% if tax paid 1-30 days late, 10% if over 30 days

state_tax_on_llc.name: Franchise (margin) tax - no tax due threshold
state_tax_on_llc.applies: every taxable entity incl. LLCs and single-member LLCs organized in Texas or with nexus
state_tax_on_llc.notes: Reports due 2026 and 2027: no tax due if annualized total revenue is at or below $2,650,000 (was $2,470,000 for 2024-2025). Since report year 2024 the No Tax Due Report (Form 05-163) is discontinued: entities at or below the threshold owe nothing and file only the PIR or OIR ($0).

state_tax_on_llc.name: Franchise (margin) tax rate
state_tax_on_llc.applies: taxable margin of entities above $2,650,000 revenue (reports due 2026-2027)
state_tax_on_llc.notes: 0.375% for retail or wholesale; 0.75% other. EZ computation: 0.331% of apportioned revenue for total revenue up to $20 million. Compensation deduction limit $480,000.

sources.title: Franchise Tax - Texas Comptroller
sources.quote: 2026 and 2027 Item Amount No Tax Due Threshold $2,650,000 Tax Rate (retail or wholesale) 0.375% Tax Rate (other than retail or wholesale) 0.75%

sources.title: No Tax Due Reporting for Report Years 2024 and Later
sources.quote: Does not owe any tax. Is not required to file a No Tax Due Report. Is required to file a Public Information Report or Ownership Information Report.

entity_level_taxes.name: Franchise (margin) tax
entity_level_taxes.notes: S corporations are taxable entities; same $2,650,000 no-tax-due threshold and 0.375%/0.75% rates (reports due 2026-2027). No personal income tax, so the federal S election has no state income tax effect.

estimated_tax.notes: Franchise tax is an annual report due May 15; no individual estimated payments.

notable: No-tax-due threshold raised to $2,650,000 for franchise tax reports due 2026 and 2027 (https://comptroller.texas.gov/taxes/franchise/)

Since report year 2024 the No Tax Due Report is gone: an LLC under the threshold files only the free Public Information Report by May 15 (https://comptroller.texas.gov/taxes/franchise/ntd-rpt-updates-2024.php)
Single-member LLCs are taxable entities for franchise tax, unlike sole proprietorships (https://comptroller.texas.gov/taxes/publications/98-806.php)
Qualifying new veteran-owned businesses file no franchise report or PIR during their first five years (https://comptroller.texas.gov/taxes/franchise/ntd-rpt-updates-2024.php)
No state or local individual income tax
